title: Frontend plumbing: path builders, apiBlob, shared status/provenance components, source-model hook
description:
Add the plumbing that every wave-2 frontend package needs, so none of them edit shared files.

Path builders and route patterns: childParentView, childQuickBaseline, childTeacherObservation, childPlan, childObservations, childReports, plus a parent-wizard step route if needed.

lib/api.ts gains apiBlob(path, body) for the PDF download. The existing api() reads responses as text or JSON. apiBlob must keep the same-origin, CSRF and error-envelope handling.

lib/sourceModel.ts is a cached hook for GET /api/source-model.

components/source/** holds three components:
- StatusPill (not_started / in_progress / sufficient / review_later; never a percentage);
- ProvenanceBadge (a visible text chip, not tooltip-only; PARENT SAID / TEACHER OBSERVED / AI SUGGESTED / TEACHER APPROVED; optional "entered by {name}" line);
- NotAnswered / NotObserved muted markers.

All of them use logical CSS properties for RTL and carry en/ar/he strings in common.json.

The working tree has uncommitted branding changes (AppShell.tsx, index.css, icons, favicon, components/brand, api-auth and ui-shell tests). Do not touch them; ask the lead to commit or stash them first.
acceptance: vitest passes, including the banned-terms scan over the new common.json strings
apiBlob returns a Blob for application/pdf, surfaces the JSON error envelope on 4xx/5xx, and the caller can revoke the object URL (test)
the components render correctly in he/ar (dir=rtl) and en with snapshot or role tests; ProvenanceBadge text is visible without hover

title: PDF export: WeasyPrint pipeline, 6 report types, RTL-correct templates, export log, Reports tab
description:
Implement §6 and X-40..X-57.

Dependencies: add weasyprint (latest stable, pinned) and Jinja2 to requirements.txt, and pdfminer.six, pypdf and python-bidi to requirements-dev.txt.

Fonts: bundle Rubik, NotoSansHebrew and NotoSansArabic TTFs plus OFL.txt in backend/app/reports/fonts. Download them on the server from the official Google Fonts or Noto repositories. The server already has Pango 1.52, HarfBuzz 8.3 and fonts-noto-core.

Package layout (§6.2): service.py, builders/<6 types>.py, i18n.py with messages/{en,ar,he}.json, render.py, templates/, static/report.css and page-{ltr,rtl}.css.
- Builders read only the DB and the registries (data/source/*.json) and must never import app.ai.
- Use a local-only url_fetcher.
- Render to bytes in memory, under a BoundedSemaphore(1) with a timeout that returns REPORT_BUSY.

API:
- POST /api/children/{id}/reports/pdf with ReportRequest (§4.4), using staff_child. On success insert a report_exports row and an audit 'report.export' row, then return an attachment with no-store and nosniff headers.
- GET /api/children/{id}/reports returns the export log.

Layout and RTL rules are in §6.3: running header and footer with the disclaimer and page x/y; logical CSS; bdi isolation; Western digits; source attribution labels; approved AI text only.

Deploy: the systemd unit gets XDG_CACHE_HOME plus a ReadWritePaths entry for it.

Frontend: features/reports holds the Reports tab and export dialog (§5.9), using apiBlob from WP1-FE.

Until WP2-PQ and WP2-TO land, build R2 and R3 against fixture registries in tests/fixtures/reports. WP3 switches them to the real ones.
acceptance: test_reports_rtl.py on the server renders real he, ar and en PDFs for every report type and checks: (1) the glyphs sorted by x match bidi.get_display(expected) for mixed Hebrew/Arabic lines with numbers, dates and Latin words; (2) 'ببب' uses 3 pairwise-different glyph cids, all different from an isolated 'ب', and all map to U+0628; (3) the first header cell of every he/ar table has the largest x0; (4) RTL paragraph lines end within 1pt of the right content edge; (5) every page has the disclaimer and 'x / y', and page 1 has the child name, age and kindergarten; (6) only the bundled fonts are embedded

content rules: no '%', 'score' or 'points'; unapproved AI drafts are absent; the health section and Q41 appear only with include_health / include_family; R2 lists every registry question in source order with 'Not answered' for empty ones

API: 401 without a session; 404 for a parent and for an out-of-scope teacher; exactly one report_exports row and one audit row per successful export and none on failure; Content-Disposition attachment and Cache-Control private, no-store; no new files under /tmp
rendering R1 for the seeded child keeps peak RSS under 250 MB; a concurrent second request waits or returns 503 REPORT_BUSY

vitest: the export dialog defaults the language to the UI locale, sends the include flags, downloads a blob and revokes the object URL; banned-terms scan passes for reports.json; backend messages pass key parity and the banned-terms check with the disclaimer allow_phrases
